mesh.description: Mesh with geometry, material and position

template.description: Reusable property block for a node type, applied with .name

override.description: A body appended to every node the selector matches — type, #id and .template, chained by descendant

bakery.description: Lightmap baker settings — on the sheet, a node or a material

broom.description: Editor settings — on the sheet, or on a node the editor treats as an object

entity.description: Data this node carries into the game — the project names the fields

entitynode.description: An entity: data placed at a point, with no geometry of its own

fields.description: What an @entity key is — the editor's box comes from this

locale.description: The sheet's translation table, keyed by the source text

brush.description: A box brush — six half-spaces, wound counter-clockwise seen from outside, sharing one material

face.description: One plane of a brush, through three points wound counter-clockwise seen from outside

ref.description: The instance built for a #id declared elsewhere in the sheet

repeat.description: Unroll this block n times, with --index and --count bound in each copy

find.description: Reach into a node built by a loader and set properties on it

play.description: Play an animation clip that came with the loaded model

each.description: A list: the value once per index, or once per item of a list. Binds --i, --index and --count

ring.description: A ring of points around the y axis — one cross section of a loftGeometry()
